tests.stimulus: First write 5 items to establish a nonempty history, asynchronously assert rst during a window when both clocks are low, and hold it for at least two write/read clock periods; after reset is released, write different data and read it out. During reset, we=re=0.
tests.expected: After reset assertion, the two status values are full=0 and empty=1; the first item after reset release is independent of the pre-reset queue; undefined empty data is not compared.
tests.checker: fifo_scoreboard::write samples actual from the native ports and generates expected from input history using dvbench_model in the same file; flags are compared using four-state case equality, and data is compared point by point when nonempty and expected is known, with uvm_error on a mismatch; check_phase requires at least 200 status points and 32 valid data points.

tests.stimulus: Empty the logical queue, hold re=0, set we and data on w_clk falling edges, and pass through 16 accepting rising edges, with data covering 00, FF, 55, AA, and incrementing values; continue issuing 4 writes while full, then issue read requests; repeat filling and draining to wrap the positions multiple times.
tests.expected: After accepting the 16th item, full=1; writes while full do not overwrite storage; subsequent valid nonempty data matches the memory prediction based on independent input history.
tests.checker: fifo_scoreboard::write samples actual from the native ports and generates expected from input history using dvbench_model in the same file; flags are compared using four-state case equality, and data is compared point by point when nonempty and expected is known, with uvm_error on a mismatch; check_phase requires at least 200 status points and 32 valid data points.

tests.stimulus: First write each slot and hold re=0 to observe the combinational response of the first item, then apply read requests in the independent r_clk domain, including reads while empty; interleave with writes, changing we/wdata while the read position is held to observe the latest contents of the corresponding slot.
tests.expected: rdata is the combinational value at the current read position; the read position moves only on an r_clk rising edge with re asserted and nonempty before the edge; reads while empty do not move the position; data in nonempty, known slots equals the prediction.
tests.checker: fifo_scoreboard::write samples actual from the native ports and generates expected from input history using dvbench_model in the same file; flags are compared using four-state case equality, and data is compared point by point when nonempty and expected is known, with uvm_error on a mismatch; check_phase requires at least 200 status points and 32 valid data points.

tests.stimulus: Use a 10ns write period and a 14ns read period, drive 00, 10, and 01 requests, and include w_clk state updates without an r_clk edge; calculate both positions and pre-edge flags from the input history, processing edges in chronological order and handling coincident times.
tests.expected: 1ns after every w_clk and r_clk rising edge, full/empty must match the independent model; an r_clk edge alone must not directly update flags, and the read-candidate comparison must not be mistaken for an ordinary occupancy count.
tests.checker: fifo_scoreboard::write samples actual from the native ports and generates expected from input history using dvbench_model in the same file; flags are compared using four-state case equality, and data is compared point by point when nonempty and expected is known, with uvm_error on a mismatch; check_phase requires at least 200 status points and 32 valid data points.

tests.stimulus: Apply we=re=1 after each of three types of history: filled first, drained first, and partially occupied, holding continuously for 1 to 4 write cycles; the two 10ns/14ns clocks include coincident rising edges, with data 55, AA, and random values.
tests.expected: Reject writes when full and reads when empty; between these boundaries, each side accepts on its own clock, and the w_clk state updates according to boundary priority; coincident edges use the old state without dependence on simulation ordering.
tests.checker: fifo_scoreboard::write samples actual from the native ports and generates expected from input history using dvbench_model in the same file; flags are compared using four-state case equality, and data is compared point by point when nonempty and expected is known, with uvm_error on a mismatch; check_phase requires at least 200 status points and 32 valid data points.

tests.stimulus: Maintain independent 10ns and 14ns clocks throughout, drive controls on w_clk falling edges, and additionally insert asynchronous resets; randomize 400 sets of we/re/data and hold times of 1 to 4 write cycles, monitoring both types of clock edges and reset assertion each time.
tests.expected: Compare model-predicted flags and known valid data 1ns after each relevant event; do not backfill the model with actual DUT outputs, do not check empty/unknown data, and do not substitute coverage hits for functional comparisons.
